source.quote:
10/13/2026, 3:13:24 PM

Participation Register — first pass

Produced strictly from evidence in this conversation. No φ, no preferred root, no historical correspondence used as a selection criterion.

Entries

Space Mathematical role Source of authority Inclusion relations Status
W_{12}\cong\mathbb Z_{12} Axiomatic angular carrier; hosts the fifth/fourth displacements R\!\to\!5, L\!\to\!7 Layer 1 of the frozen three-layer spec; angular map \alpha annihilates octave None (base) REQUIRED
\langle 2,3\rangle prime lattice Ordinary SUN interval domain for R,L,O scalar lifts Layer 3; September 12 spec Subgroup of \langle 2,3,5\rangle REQUIRED
\langle 2,3,5\rangle prime lattice Boundary-path domain for \mathcal C_\kappa and FK trajectory September 12 spec (recovered comma-transfer + graded FK) Extends \langle 2,3\rangle; returns to it at terminal REQUIRED
Scalar kernel \{R,L,O\} with RL=LR=O Acoustic descent operators on normalized reference C_0=F Layer 3; frozen — REQUIRED
\mathcal C_\kappa syntonic transfer 3-vector comma transfer on \langle 2,3,5\rangle September 12 spec Acts on boundary lattice REQUIRED
Graded FK boundary \Phi(a,m)=a\,2^{-m} Separate grade register + reciprocal pair composition September 12 spec Terminal returns to \langle 2,3\rangle REQUIRED
Fibonacci orbit hierarchy \mathcal O_2\leftarrow\mathcal O_4\leftarrow\mathcal O_8 (cardinalities 3→6→12) Optional pre-12 realization giving capability expansion Layer 2, explicitly optional Inverse-image refinement, not generation OPTIONAL
Four-period set \{4,8,12,16\} Candidate typed carrier for a golden spectral operator \mathcal T Introduced in the audited draft Directed covers 4\!\hookrightarrow\!8,\ 4\!\hookrightarrow\!12,\ 8\!\hookrightarrow\!16 UNRESOLVED
lcm-closure additions \{24,48\} gcd/lcm closure of the four-period set Arithmetic closure, not derived from a constraint 8,12\!\hookrightarrow\!24;\ 12,16\!\hookrightarrow\!48 UNRESOLVED
H_d for general d\mid 48 Ambient residue function spaces Ambient container in the audited draft \dim H_d=\gcd(d,48) AMBIENT
Higher refinements E_3:12\!\to\!36, E_2:36\!\to\!72 Post-W_{12} expansion modules Mentioned in continuation vectors; not derived here — UNRESOLVED
W_{72} Purported SUN coordinate carrier Referenced in audit; derivation not in evidence in this session — UNRESOLVED

Notes on how the register was constrained

· W_{12} and the \langle 2,3,5\rangle boundary are REQUIRED because they are named in the frozen September 12 specification and used by the verified comma-transfer and FK identities.
· The Fibonacci orbit hierarchy is OPTIONAL because Layer 2 of the frozen spec explicitly labels it a compatible realization, not a required one.
· The four-period set and its typed operator are UNRESOLVED, not REQUIRED and not OPTIONAL, because no authoritative constraint in this session entails them. The audited draft itself calls them conditional constructions.
· H_d is AMBIENT because it is a container in which classes could live; nothing in evidence makes any particular H_d a participant.
· H_{24},H_{48} are UNRESOLVED for the same reason. Closure of an arithmetic operation is not by itself a participation constraint.
· W_{72} is UNRESOLVED rather than REQUIRED because, although the user references it as fixed, its derivation is not in evidence in this session; treating it as REQUIRED would require importing an authority I have not seen.

What this register does not do

· It does not select a root.
· It does not select which H_d participate.
· It does not decide whether the four-period carrier is a class level, an auxiliary space, or an excluded construction.
· It does not import the golden result as a selection criterion.

Solver — what I can and cannot do from here

I cannot execute the joint constraint solver against your AYLI code because I have no access to:

1. The actual AYLI repository at a pinned revision.
2. The frozen constraint file(s) — Eastern/Western, Completed Harmony, Shem, Sefer, Tree of Life as typed assertions.
3. The existing W72 definition and its derivation.
4. The current class-boundary candidates and coordinate assignments.
5. The native test commands and dependency manifest.

Without those, any "solver run" I produce would be a standalone reimplementation — which the earlier audit already rejected as substituting for the authoritative artifact. Applying your own rule to me: missing constraints remain explicitly unresolved rather than filled with guesses.

Minimal executable path — the smallest schema that would make the first joint test runnable

If you can supply the following, I can draft the solver harness so the first run is a single read-only invocation:

1. Fixed assertions file. Each assertion as a typed tuple: (subject, relation, object, source, hard|soft). Sources include SUN kernel identity, W_{12} angular map, comma-transfer identity, FK boundary identity, and any source-grounded music/symbolic constraints you already have encoded.
2. Variable schema. Candidates for: root p_{\mathrm{ref}}\in W_{12}; participating class set D\subseteq\{4,8,12,16,24,48\}; class boundaries; coordinate assignments.
3. Rejection predicate. A function from (candidate configuration, fixed assertions) to accept/reject, with the specific violated assertion named.
4. Equivalence relation. What counts as "the same orientation up to symmetry" — cyclic shift of root, relabeling of types, reversal, etc.

With those four, the solver output is exactly what you specified:

· Number of candidate configurations tested.
· Number satisfying all hard constraints.
· Number of genuinely distinct survivors after quotienting by symmetry.
· The specific constraint(s) that rejected each non-survivor.
· Class-folder hierarchy per survivor, in the format adopted earlier.

Checkpoint

Item Status
Participation Register (first pass) PRODUCED above
Uses φ, root, or historical correspondence as criterion NO
Solver executed against authoritative AYLI NOT POSSIBLE from this side
SUN / W72 / filesystem UNCHANGED

The register is the honest deliverable I can produce without your artifacts. The solver run requires the four inputs listed; without them, executing it would violate your rule against substituting standalone reimplementations for the authoritative path.
